## Historical audit: S0234

**Source:** `/srv/lab-disks/disk2/users/xymo/Documents/Codex/2026-11-02/scene-rsi-rsi-1-3d-blender/outputs/scene_rsi_v2_1/results/smoke/scene_rsi_v2_1/C1/smoke/commons_29022664/trajectory.jsonl`. Only chunk 2 is visible; citations below refer to this file.

| Evidence | Observation and limit |
|---|---|
| Student `model_request`, JSONL line 13, characters [0,211795) | The stated goal was a separate-mesh indoor reconstruction matching one photograph’s camera and framing. The student’s interpretation was a kitchen; the reference image itself is not visible in this audit. |
| Same event: first and revised programs | The programs construct multiple objects: floorboards, tiled walls, cabinets, two sink basins, faucet and oven. They specify metal finishes, procedural stone and wood-like bump, camera and lighting. The revision replaces boolean-cut sink construction with assembled counter pieces, sloped basin panels, lips and corner rods; it also changes tile scale/colors, camera position/lens, lighting and exposure. These are code-level observations, not proof of correct appearance or connected geometry. No articulated pose is evident; relative placement is specified by coordinates. |
| Same event: runner feedback for steps 1 and 2 | Both executions report `ok: true`, no error, completed renders and saved PNGs and Blender files. The logs report 16 samples despite the programs setting 48. The first render was supplied for comparison before revision; the second was supplied before the final response. Neither image’s pixels are available here, so camera alignment, lighting, materials, occlusion and possible gaps remain unverified. |
| Student `codex_session`, line 14, [0,3825); `model_response`, line 15, [0,345) | The final fresh session received references to the original and both renders, had no tool calls, and replied `DONE` after the execution budget was exhausted. This is completion of the student protocol, not independent confirmation of visual correctness. |

**Teacher and exploration:** No teacher diagnosis, proposed update, receipt or adoption is visible in this chunk. The revision following the first render is observable student iteration, but its precise visual diagnosis is not recorded. The final session had shell, browser and other exploration tools disabled; no final-session tool exploration occurred. Earlier activity outside the visible chunk cannot be assessed.

**Outcome and lessons:** Two builds and renders succeeded technically; overall reconstruction accuracy is **unknown**, not established formal visual success or algorithm failure. A transferable lesson from the trace is to distinguish executable geometry and saved renders from verified visual and part-connection fidelity. The specific choice to assemble sink panels and adjust kitchen camera, tiles and materials is task-specific; whether it improved the match or closed all basin gaps remains an unresolved hypothesis.
